Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be as given in specifications from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Case File No.- DPS/IRPU/PG-I/73386 Note: Bidders offering must also comply with the addit ional specifications parameters mentioned in the ATC document , in the event of non-fulfillment/compliance the offers may be rejected. A) All items, terms & conditions, specifications are as per Bid docu ment/attached annexure.

B) Packing/Delivery Note: In case of an order, all the packages inva riably will have details (Superscribed) like GeM Contract No., Co nsignee Name, Consignor name, Phone No., etc to avoid refusal o f the consignment at the time of delivery. OTP based delivery is not acceptable at receipt section. C) The Bank details of the bidders shall be provided along with the offers for financial transactions. D) Supply of the Items must be done in Single lot only. E) Drivers should carry Original Transport Driving License and Vehi cles should posses all the Required Valid Original Road document s such as Registration Certificate Insurance, Fitness and etc., oth erwise the vehicles will not be permitted in RRCAT for Delivery. F) Bidder Qualification Criteria: 1.The OEM should have indigenous direct support centre to provi de technical support. Contact details of the support centre shoul d be provided with the offer. 2.The Bidder should either be the OEM or an OEM authorized rep resentative distributor. The Bidder should submit a tender-specif ic Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) from the OEM, stating that they are authorized for the supply, installation, and commis sioning of the offered equipment in India. G) Acceptance Criteria: 1. The system shall be considered technically accepted only upon s uccessful completion of Installation, Testing & Commissioning. 2. Technical acceptance is contingent upon: a) Full compliance with the Technical Specification, as verified on t he installed system and recorded in the Compliance Statement. b) Successful completion of the benchmark test on the CPU. c) Successful completion of the benchmark test on the GPU. 3. Any non-conformance identified during acceptance verification shall be rectified by the bidder, and the affected item(s) re-tested, be fore technical acceptance is recorded. Technical acceptance shall be recorded in writing by the institute 's technical representative, based on the bidder's commissioning test report and the institute's own verification. H) Bid Evaluation Criteria: Bids shall be evaluated on the basis of t he overall lowest total value for the entire order, inclusive of all i tems, and the Three (3) year warranty. I) Installation, Testing and Commissioning Clause:

1) Installation has to be carried out at RRCAT, Indore. 2) Installation, testing, and commissioning shall be carried out by an OEM-certified engineer, or an engineer from the OEM's authorized service partner. 3) Scope of installation includes unboxing, cabling (power and net work), operating system installation, GPU driver and firmware install ation and BIOS configuration. 4) Every parameter as per bid specifications and additional specific ation parameters shall be physically verified on the delivered system using standard OS-level verification tools (e.g., processor and memor y utilities) against the values committed by the bidder. 5) The system shall undergo a benchmark test on the CPU, achievin g a minimum sustained double-precision (FP64) throughput of 70% of the calculated theoretical peak performance for that specific process or model — derived from its published core count, clock speed, and v ector instruction width. 6) The system's GPU shall undergo a compute benchmark test, exe cuted at full precision, at a sufficiently large problem size to reach st eady-state throughput, achieving a minimum sustained throughput of 80% of the published peak performance for that specific GPU model. 7) Commissioning shall be deemed complete only upon written sig n-off by RRCAT representative supported by test report from bidder c overing installed configuration, OS, firmware versions, driver version s, compute performance and LLM inference tests. 8) Any component found not matching the declared specification, o r found non-functional or unstable during testing, shall be replaced o r rectified by the bidder, and re-tested, before commissioning is consi dered complete. J) Upload Manufacturer authorization: Wherever Authorised Distrib utors are submitting the bid, Manufacturers Authorization Form ( MAF)/Certificate with OEM details such as name, designation, ad dress, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished alongwit h the bid. K) Procuring Entity’s right without assigning any reason to: a) Reject any or all of the Bids or b) Cancel the tender process, or c) Abandon the procurement of the goods, or d) Issue another tender for identical or similar goods. L) GST registration certificate consisting of Annexure A & B shall b e furnished along with your offer.
